correctness.rationale: The graded 1,2,3,2,1 dimensions, Frobenius cube-zero identity and filtration-preserving change-of-generator argument establish the nonzero-linear (6,3) stratum. The quadratic middle block determinant b^2-ac simultaneously controls rank and square rank; nonzero quadratic-to-socle perfect pairing gives rank=2+rank(block) even with cubic/quartic perturbations. The conic has q^2-1 nonzero affine points. Cubic and quartic strata follow from perfect socle pairing. All counts sum to q^8, and a direct full GF(3) 9x9 rank calculation checks all 6561 cases; GF(9) checks stratified extension-field cases. The all-q conclusion comes from proof, not experiments.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural invariant of the smallest odd-characteristic rank-two elementary-abelian modular group algebra, not a selectively chosen finite slice. It gives every Jordan partition and exact field-uniform multiplicity, exhibits the forbidden rank five and the projective-conic rank-three degeneracy in the nonlinear augmentation strata. The exact finite-field data are not implied by generic linear-form Lefschetz/Jordan results and can serve as a first characteristic-three regular-module benchmark; no generalization or paper-sized novelty is assumed.
